knownLimitation.what: Nothing on the wire tells hauska-map a county's grade, so src/lib/county-grade.ts holds the six by FIPS. It is written as a pointer at the authority (OPS-16 plan of record; LDT's PARCEL_RECORD_SLATE) with an explicit do-not-edit warning, and the test pins the wording so drift is visible — but it IS a second place a county list exists, and the canon's standing rule is never to add a vocabulary copy. The clean fix is for the PE facet payload to carry the county grade, after which that file names no counties at all. Declared rather than hidden.
knownLimitation.consequentialGap: Until that wire field exists, the statement is proven on fixtures but will NOT appear on a live Bell card, because nothing in a live payload marks Bell as ungraded.
